technology_name: Safe & Scalable Sweet Flag Clones for Pharma Use: In Vitro Acorus calamus
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: High toxicity and carcinogenic risks associated with elevated ß-asarone levels in natural sweet flag (Acorus calamus) varieties, which restricts their safe commercial and pharmaceutical use.
description: Identification of elite, low ß-asarone accessions of Acorus calamus (sweet flag) and the development of rapid in vitro multiplication protocols using biotechnological interventions. This approach facilitates the large-scale, sustainable propagation of pharmacologically effective and safe sweet flag clones that comply with USFDA, WHO, and European Commission regulatory limits regarding ß-asarone toxicity.
applications:
• Commercial cultivation of safe, regulatory-compliant medicinal herbs for agriculture

• Extraction of low-toxicity calamus oil for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations

• Supply chains for traditional medicine and modern therapeutic manufacturing

• Sustainable mass-propagation services via commercial plant tissue culture labs
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
